raw_query: Find the entry function that handles user login authentication

include.intent_statement: Does this function serve as the primary entry point for processing user login and verifying credentials?
include.description: Identifies functions whose core purpose is to receive and process login requests, including credential validation.

include.code_ql:
import python
from Callable c
where c.hasName("login") or c.hasName("authenticate") or c.hasName("signin") or c.getAnalyzedFile().getFilePath().matches("%route%") or c.hasAnnotation("Route") or c.hasAnnotation("APIRoute") or c.hasAnnotation("app.route") or c.hasAnnotation("@http_post")
select c
include.description: Finds top-level callable functions that are entry points (e.g., route handlers, API endpoints) and match login/authentication naming or annotation patterns.
